storeSettings.returnPolicy:
Golden Soul Golf stands behind the quality of every item we manufacture. Our goal is that all our finished goods exceed our customers’ expectations. If for any reason you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, we accept returns of unused items within 30 days of purchase for a full refund.

If you would like to return an item, there is no restocking fee. However, the customer is responsible for the shipping cost. If you wish to exchange your item, we will send the new product back to you at no additional shipping charge.

We do not accept returned items after 30 days from the purchase date.

items.title: Muxi Sunday
items.excerpt:
Designed and built entirely in-house, this golf bag is a tribute to thoughtful craftsmanship and the spirit of the walking golfer. We partnered with skilled artisans from the highlands of Boyacá, Colombia—renowned for their centuries-old wool-working tradition—to source and handweave the finest virgin wool available.

Every element of this bag was considered with purpose: the streamlined pocket layout ensures easy access to essentials, the ergonomic double straps offer balanced comfort, and the three-way club divider provides practical organization without excess.

Despite its artisanal roots, this bag is made to be used. The materials were carefully chosen not only for their beauty, but for their durability—requiring no special care beyond what any great golf bag deserves.

A piece born of tradition, crafted for performance, and designed with much love for the arts and game.

items.title: The Belmont Sunday
items.excerpt:
This all-leather golf bag is the result of years of refinement and our pursuit of excellence in both design and material. Crafted entirely in-house, it reflects our commitment to quality, function, and aesthetic balance.

We’ve built close relationships with some of the most respected tanneries in Colombia—ensuring access to leathers of unmatched character and durability. The result is a bag that not only looks refined but is built to endure the elements and the rhythm of the walking golfer.

With a thoughtfully designed pocket layout, comfortable double straps, and a clean three-way club divider, every detail serves a purpose. This bag is made to be carried, not just admired—requiring no special treatment, only use.

Crafted with intention, shaped by experience, and designed with much love for the arts and game.

With a thoughtfully designed pocket layout, comfortable double straps, and a clean three-way club divider, every detail serves a purpose. This bag is made to be carried, not just admired—requiring no special treatment, only use.

Crafted with intention, shaped by experience, and designed with much love for the arts and game.
